title: resolvePreferredProvider
responsibility: Resolve which Tracker provider is active at a time and describe the scheduled switch.

inputs.name: resolvePreferredProvider.setting
inputs.description: Preferred provider and optional timestamp and destination provider.

inputs.name: resolvePreferredProvider.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the selection is made.

outputs.name: resolvePreferredProvider
outputs.description: The active provider and the reason displayed with the model selection.
